name: hub
//: Hive hub UI - the owner's console. Next.js App Router + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui, exported statically to out/ which the hive binary embeds (crates/hive-hub/src/server.rs, rust-embed). out/ is a build product, never committed: crates/hive-hub/build.rs runs `npm run build` (after `npm ci` when node_modules is missing or older than package-lock.json) whenever cargo builds hive-hub and src/, public/ or one of the config files here changed; without Node the binary gets a placeholder page, HIVE_HUB_SKIP_BUILD=1 embeds the out/ already on disk.
dev:        `npm run dev` on :3000 proxies /api/* to the hive hub - run `hive hub --no-browser --port 8787` first (HIVE_HUB_PORT overrides the port).
dev:mock:   `npm run dev:mock` runs mock/server.mjs (fixtures in mock/api/**.json, writes answered in memory, SSE at /api/v1/events/stream) on :8787 and next dev on :3000. No hub needed.
build:      `npm run build` = static export to out/ (gitignored). `npm run serve:out` serves out/ plus the mock API on :8787 (the same layout the hive hub serves) for a last look at the export.
check:      `npm run check` = typecheck (tsc --noEmit) + lint (eslint) + build + test. All API calls are relative /api/v1/...; the TypeScript contract lives in src/lib/api.ts.

routes:     / (hub), /project/?slug=&tab=, /tasks/, /votes/?project=&status=&kind=, /records/?id=, /compute/, /settings/, /harness/, /connections/?project=&tab= - state in search params, no dynamic segments.

design:     "the daily briefing" - plain words (src/lib/words.ts is the vocabulary: runner, machines, private tests, statusWord()), marigold only for what waits on the owner, flat cards, details folded. Tokens live in src/app/globals.css (oklch palette from .github/assets/hive-logo.svg; ink primary buttons, teal for links/focus/active nav, marigold `you`, one --kind-*/--status-* tint per kind and status, series colours for charts). Geist Sans and Geist Mono (variable woff2, OFL-geist.txt) are vendored in public/fonts and preloaded; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Mono stay vendored beside them (latin + latin-ext, OFL-atkinson-*.txt) as the Readable font option (`<html data-font="readable">`, Settings > Appearance, src/components/shell/appearance-state.ts) so the export needs no network at build or run time. Adding something (a model provider, a machine, a tool) is a step-by-step modal wizard on the shared Stepper (src/components/hive/stepper.tsx) ending in a review step; Settings shows one section at a time, named by the URL hash; the sidebar foot carries the runner and model-provider status, each linking to its fix.

overrides:  hono is a transitive dev dependency (shadcn -> @modelcontextprotocol/sdk). The override pins it to the newest patched release that was at least 3 days old when adopted (the owner's release-age rule, 2026-10-26); bump or drop the pin when a newer release is old enough. minimatch 11.0.3 is forced over every consumer (Dependabot #34, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249; owner-allowed major, 2026-11-01). v11 dropped the default export and makeRe, so eslint-plugin-react/import/jsx-a11y rules that call minimatch() (react/no-danger, react/forbid-component-props, react/jsx-pascal-case, react/jsx-handler-names, react/no-unstable-nested-components, import/order, import/no-internal-modules, import/no-extraneous-dependencies, jsx-a11y/label-has-associated-control) throw if enabled - none is in the eslint-config-next set used here; drop the pin once those plugins depend on minimatch >= 11.0.1.

scripts.dev:mock: node mock/server.mjs & MOCK=$!; HIVE_HUB_PORT=${HIVE_HUB_PORT:-8787} next dev; kill $MOCK
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
